A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (5 March 2022). Its words are the Players Committee's errata; Decipher published no errata text for this card.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-D-evacuate-PC-2022-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Evacuate?]] (December 1995): The game text is rewritten: Decipher's “Unless Tarkin is aboard, save all characters, weapons and devices aboard any just-lost capital starship. Relocate them …” becomes “If your capital starship is about to be lost, unless Tarkin aboard, relocate your characters aboard …”; the end (“to any one planet site or to one of your capital starships.”) is the same. The whole card is drawn again at a larger size, with the mark “D-E1” in the lower border.

The whole printed card image and the whole D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
